queries.Dataset Construction Strategy: We will c: Curating hardware design benchmark data from GitHub repositories, silicon-proven projects, textbooks, and StackOverflow, with domain expert screening for correctness, completeness, and diversity to evaluate large language models for RTL design automation.
queries.Test Categories and Distribution: We wil: Benchmark construction for LLM hardware design automation with 300 tests distributed across knowledge mastery, knowledge transfer, RTL design, debugging, and multimodal circuit diagram evaluation, difficulty tiering, verification coverage, and QoR metrics
queries.Testbench Enhancement Process: We will e: constraint randomization and coverage-driven testbench generation for RTL designs that maps generated stimuli to functional coverage checklists to close verification coverage gaps in LLM-aided hardware design benchmarks
queries.End-to-End Workflow Implementation: We w: Reproducible RTL-to-QoR evaluation pipeline using Icarus Verilog simulation, OpenLane physical implementation, SkyWater 130nm PDK, Yosys synthesis, and OpenSTA timing analysis for assessing LLM-generated hardware designs
queries.Comprehensive Evaluation Framework: We w: Multi-dimensional evaluation framework for large language models in hardware design automation, assessing knowledge mastery, knowledge transfer, RTL code generation, debugging, functional correctness, and quality-of-results metrics including synthesizability, power, area, and timing using EDA tools and benchmark test suites.
queries.Evaluation Metrics: We will measure perf: Functional pass rate and normalized quality-of-results evaluation for LLM-generated RTL hardware designs, including synthesizability, power, area, and timing metrics
queries.Model Evaluation Setup: We will evaluate: Evaluation of multimodal and language large language models for hardware design code generation using pass@5 sampling, standardized prompt templates, and cross-model benchmarking with circuit diagrams and RTL verification
queries.Perturbation Strategy: We will implement: Perturbation strategies for LLM hardware design benchmarking that alter phrasing or underlying requirements to reduce memorization bias, with static and dynamic test instance variation for robustness evaluation
queries.Generative Benchmark Infrastructure: We: script-based generative benchmark test generation for LLM-aided hardware design with static and dynamic perturbations to prevent automated crawler extraction of RTL code and test set contamination while maintaining consistent evaluation semantics
queries.Multimodal Support: We will incorporate: Multimodal large language model benchmark for hardware design using circuit diagrams, architecture schematics, waveform diagrams, tables, and textual specifications
queries.Difficulty Tiering Mechanism: We will ca: difficulty tiering benchmark for evaluating large language models in hardware design automation using simple intermediate and tough test levels to analyze model success and failure as design complexity increases
queries.Ablation Studies: We will conduct contro: Ablation study comparing original and dynamically perturbed hardware design benchmark test sets to measure large language model robustness, sensitivity to surface and semantic perturbations, and resistance to memorization in LLM-aided RTL code generation evaluation
